newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal cuts rate on certs deposit to 6.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal cuts rate on certs deposit to 6.3 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it cut the rate paid on certificates of deposit by 0.4 percentage points to 6.3 percent.
The central bank issued the CDs to mop up funds unfrozen by a cut in the cash reserve requirement for commercial banks to two percent from 17 percent in November 1994.
The rate paid on the interest-bearing certificates, which have maturities ranging from two to 10 years, is reviewed quarterly.
The certificates of deposit are traded on the interbank money market.
